# Neutral premium inventory acceptance fixture

This fixture has twelve independent entry roots and fourteen authored business calculation sites. The Chinese-only source and the renamed linkage parameter contain no English premium token. A procedure COPY contains a calculation; an LF/PF chain supplies a rate. A report transfer and a counter are negative controls.

`gold.json` is authored independently of the index/retrieval implementation. Each expected site is bound to original bytes and a physical range. Source labels explain business roles; they are not a list of correct file paths supplied to the application. The fixture is synthetic, not company code. A correct source inventory still must not claim runtime library binding or actual rate-table values.

The offline oracle measures location/evidence coverage and retained final inventory. Synthetic model replies are control inputs, not proof that a real model understands the business. Missing an expected site, accepting an excluded site, or claiming completion without visiting the required universe must fail acceptance.

The renewal program repeats the same formula in one paragraph at two physical positions; both occurrences are required independently.

The local acceptance runs the actual index, question orchestration, explicit continuation, context compaction and final review protocol. It compares all fourteen independently authored sites with actual supplied source and final visible output; saved writing requirements and Traditional Chinese output are checked separately. Previously reviewed batch items may not repeat, and the fixed snapshot catalogue must be retained. The source associations needed by CALL, COPY and LF/PF are all required to have been supplied in full.

The online acceptance exports the real synthetic index, deletes its local source/index, and uses the independent material reader, query service and investigation runner. Its scripted planner consumes only actual tool observations and source pages. An unfinished search survives more than ninety-six observations; file reviews, multi-page recall, repeated arithmetic occurrences, final location coverage and cumulative source associations are verified. Both caller/callee and logical/physical source references must remain attached to the visible relevant finding. These association checks establish retained provenance, not the correctness of a real model's causal business explanation.

Negative oracles reject a first-batch claim of completeness, omission only from final visible prose, clipped/forged source, wrong references, unrelated arithmetic and loss of a required source association. No live model, company repository, runtime rate values, target-device behaviour or desktop executable is exercised by this fixture.
